answer: Require each identity to post a slashable bond that only seasons after peers verify real work across a full epoch. Like saffron, value comes from many costly hand-picked threads, not one cheap bloom; a juniper planted today cannot fake years of rings. Run a beacon check that links wallets sharing funding or behavior: if one linked fake is caught cheating, the whole cluster's bonds burn. A thousand sybils then means a thousand seasoned bonds at risk, so cloning costs more than honest work earns.
